scope: Explicit selective executable checks for observed public contracts. These data do not route or alter production answers, select successful latency outcomes, or certify every interview implementation.

checks.entryPointSelection: Exactly one recorded top-level Python function taking N, edges, S and T positionally. The recorded recognized name differs from the spoken name; neither is repaired.
checks.contract: Directed finite graph with exact signed integer edge weights, zero-indexed vertices, parallel edges and self-loops allowed, empty walk allowed. Return unreachable/None, finite/exact minimum cost, or unbounded/None for source-target walk cost.
